title: PardoGarcia2026: Mu/beta motor-imagery EEG in chronic MCA stroke and healthy controls
description: Two-class hand motor-imagery EEG (precision pinch vs closed fist) recorded from chronic middle cerebral artery stroke patients, measured before and after rehabilitation, and from healthy controls. The recordings are 63-channel BrainVision EEG sampled at 1000 Hz, and the exposed interval covers the pre-execution imagery and preparation phase before a later auditory go cue. The dataset supports study of mu and beta oscillatory changes (event-related desynchronization) associated with motor recovery. This is a BIDS re-release of the Zenodo source data produced via MOABB.
methods_description: Participants were shown image cues for a precision pinch or a closed fist and imagined and prepared the grip, with overt execution following a later auditory go cue. EEG was recorded with a BrainVision system (Ag/AgCl electrodes, Electro-Cap, 10-10 montage, 63 channels including EOG, 1000 Hz, right mastoid reference). Patients were recorded at baseline (ses-0pre) and post-rehabilitation (ses-1post), and healthy controls once.
